title: Hermes: готовность браузерного инструмента, сохранение источников между ходами и наблюдение задержек
problem: На Windows Hermes выбирал POSIX npm shim вместо установленного native exe (WinError 193), затем не находил Chrome при наличии Edge. Публичные RSS-доказательства исчезали после первого tool turn, провоцируя лишний поиск. Существующий queue_monitor скрывает конкретные новые ошибки как other и не отделяет целевую скорость от утверждения о зависании.
outcome: Проверенный браузерный launcher без shell и загрузки пакетов; доступные публичные источники сохраняются на ограниченное время после инструментов без повторного fetch; существующий read-only монитор выдаёт точные безопасные причины и превышение целевого времени, не заявляя Telegram delivery по Relay done.
constraints: Расширять существующие Hermes, Web Companion и queue_monitor; не создавать второй транспорт, Gateway или ledger вместо уже планируемого stabilize-hermes-tool-fallback-and-evidence.
Сохранять исходные system/developer/user/tool сообщения, tool_choice, схемы и запрет повтора неизвестного Send.
Не устанавливать браузеры или плагины автоматически; использовать существующий native agent-browser и изолированный профиль существующего браузера.
Уважать явный AGENT_BROWSER_EXECUTABLE_PATH и пользовательскую вкладку/профиль; никакого shell=True и подстановок аргументов.

Каноническое создание OpenSpec/SDD выполняется штатным брокером после свежего preview и prepare: по точному foreground owner approval либо по активной политике автоаппрува, явно включённой владельцем для Hermes-WebGPT. Сохраняются SHA плана, срок запроса, no-overwrite и strict validation.

capabilities.name: windows-browser-tool-readiness
capabilities.summary: Проверяемая готовность именно браузерного инструмента Hermes, отдельно от транспорта ChatGPT.

requirements.name: Native launcher selection
requirements.shall: The system SHALL replace only the known repository-local npm shim on Windows x64 with the verified installed native agent-browser PE executable, without invoking a shell or changing user arguments.

scenarios.name: Known Windows shim
scenarios.given: Hermes resolves its local POSIX npm shim and the native package executable is present
scenarios.then: the existing resolver uses one native executable argv item and records the actual Gateway PID and loaded helper hashes

scenarios.name: Foreign or invalid launcher
scenarios.given: the resolver points outside the known package or the native PE/package identity is invalid
scenarios.then: no executable replacement or arbitrary installation occurs

requirements.name: Existing browser fallback
requirements.shall: The system SHALL preserve an explicit browser executable setting and otherwise select an existing verified Chrome or Edge executable without touching a user profile.

scenarios.name: Edge installed
scenarios.given: Chrome discovery fails and Edge is present in a known Windows installation location
scenarios.then: AGENT_BROWSER_EXECUTABLE_PATH points to that existing executable and a controlled test uses its own session

scenarios.name: Explicit user choice
scenarios.then: the setting is preserved even if unavailable and no browser is silently installed

requirements.name: Truthful activation evidence
requirements.shall: The system SHALL distinguish source installation, native CLI readiness, actual navigation, Gateway activation and Telegram delivery.

scenarios.name: Loaded build
scenarios.given: the Gateway was restarted during a verified idle window
scenarios.then: runtime PID and helper hashes match the running Gateway and Telegram connection state is checked

scenarios.name: Offline-only evidence
scenarios.given: only unit tests or a CLI version probe succeeded
scenarios.then: live browser navigation and Telegram delivery remain explicitly unconfirmed

capabilities.name: followup-source-continuity
capabilities.summary: Ограниченный cache уже найденных публичных доказательств для следующих model-only ходов.

requirements.name: Bounded public evidence cache
requirements.shall: The system SHALL retain at most twelve public evidence entries for at most 300 monotonic seconds, keyed by the exact latest user request hash without storing raw private user text in the cache.

scenarios.name: Same task tool followup
scenarios.given: public evidence was obtained on the initial user turn
scenarios.when: the same task returns a tool result within the TTL
scenarios.then: the model-only view reuses a defensive copy with evidence age and cached-no-network attribution

scenarios.name: Bound or expiry
scenarios.given: an entry expired, the monotonic clock moved backwards or the capacity was exceeded
scenarios.then: the stale or evicted entry is not reused and reads do not extend its lifetime

requirements.name: No extra fetch or fabricated evidence
requirements.shall: The system SHALL perform no new source fetch on a tool-only followup cache miss and SHALL preserve source failures and headline-only provenance.

scenarios.name: Cache miss
scenarios.given: a tool followup has no matching evidence
scenarios.then: no network collection is triggered and no evidence is invented

scenarios.name: Insufficient source data
scenarios.given: the original source collection returned no articles or timed out
scenarios.then: the same limitation remains visible and no claim of a new successful search is added

requirements.name: Canonical request preservation
requirements.shall: The system SHALL keep canonical messages, real tool results, tool schemas and tool choice unchanged when adding model-only evidence.

scenarios.name: User changes task
scenarios.given: a newer or different user message exists
scenarios.then: the previous request's evidence is not reused

scenarios.name: Mutation attempt
scenarios.when: a later model view is built
scenarios.then: the internal evidence cache and canonical request remain unchanged

capabilities.name: response-quality-observation
capabilities.summary: Доработка существующего queue_monitor вместо второго сервиса: типы ошибок и явные временные цели.

requirements.name: Typed redacted failure categories
requirements.shall: The existing read-only queue monitor SHALL preserve supported browser/bootstrap/draft failure codes while mapping untrusted unknown reasons to other.

scenarios.name: Known browser failure
scenarios.given: a new request is blocked by content_tab_not_ready or tab_create_unverified
scenarios.when: it is compared with the previous snapshot
scenarios.then: the precise known failure is reported as new without exposing user data

scenarios.name: Private reason text
scenarios.given: a reason contains arbitrary text, a URL or credentials
scenarios.then: the value is replaced by other and never included verbatim

requirements.name: Explicit latency target
requirements.shall: The existing monitor SHALL optionally report an active request exceeding a configured response-age target separately from a stale-state alarm, using creation age rather than claiming phase duration.

scenarios.name: Slow active request
scenarios.given: an active request exceeds the configured target but not the stale threshold
scenarios.then: it reports a latency-target warning without declaring the worker dead or changing the request

scenarios.name: Completed request
scenarios.then: its creation age is not treated as current active latency

requirements.name: Windowed inference outcome report
requirements.shall: The existing monitor SHALL report recent inference outcomes using an explicitly defined request-creation window, with unknown ratios when no terminal observations exist and without equating done with Telegram ACK.

scenarios.name: Recent outcomes
scenarios.given: done, blocked and uncertain requests started inside the selected window
scenarios.then: it reports counts and the inference completion ratio with its scope and time basis

scenarios.name: No delivery receipt
scenarios.then: Telegram delivery, content correctness and p50/p95 phase latency remain unverified
